description: Bitcoin mining economics: Hashprice in USD and sats per TH/s per day, revenue split (subsidy vs fees) over the last 144 blocks, network hashrate and difficulty, and BTC price. Formula: dailyBlocksPerTh = (1e12 * 86400) / (diff * 2^32); hashprice = dailyBlocksPerTh * (totalRewardSat / 144). Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_btc_mining_pools when you need Bitcoin mining pool hashrate and block shares over 24h, 3d; crypto_btc_block when you need Detailed Bitcoin block summary by height or hash. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
